note: Prices are intentionally not published. To publish a price list, set publishPrices to true and fill in the tiers below with owner-approved figures only. The pricing page renders tiers automatically when enabled.

factors.title: Number of items
factors.body: A single recliner and a full garage are very different jobs. We look at how many pieces are going.

factors.title: Volume
factors.body: How much space the load takes up in the truck is one of the biggest drivers of cost.

factors.title: Weight
factors.body: Dense materials such as tile, concrete, and solid-wood furniture take more effort to move and can cost more to dispose of.

factors.title: Item type
factors.body: Some items, such as mattresses, appliances, and certain electronics, have their own handling or disposal requirements.

factors.title: Access difficulty
factors.body: Narrow hallways, tight doorways, attics, and crawl spaces add time and care.

factors.title: Carry distance
factors.body: A long walk from where the item sits to where the truck can park adds labor.

factors.title: Stairs and elevators
factors.body: Upper floors, walk-ups, and buildings with elevator reservations affect the time a job takes.

factors.title: Pickup location
factors.body: Where you are within our service area and how easy it is to park nearby.

factors.title: Recycling and disposal requirements
factors.body: Items that must go to specific recycling or disposal outlets can affect the quote.

factors.title: Special handling
factors.body: Disassembly, fragile items, or anything requiring extra protection or equipment.
